daily.title: Stop ITR Filing & Delete PAN? What You Need to Know
daily.summary: Discover if surrendering your PAN stops ITR filing. Learn the truth about PAN cancellation, filing obligations, and what happens if you stop filing. PAN cancellation is a narrow, documentation-driven process meant for specific situations like duplicate PANs, deceased taxpayers, or foreign nationals permanently exiting India. It was never designed as a compliance workaround. There is no provision in the Income Tax Act for "deleting" a PAN the way one might delete an app or an account.
